title: The bird and the spent tubes
logline: Three days after the Fourth: the swept pile of spent tubes on the dock and the bird on top of it, the only color in a pile of burnt cardboard. The pup asleep beside the pile. Gully's broom leaned.

panels.composition: A swept pile of spent firework tubes on dock planks with the small rainbow bird perched on top, a small three-legged dog asleep beside it, a broom leaned on the shack.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a swept pile of spent cardboard firework tubes on wooden dock planks with a small rainbow bird perched on top and a small three-legged dog asleep beside it, a broom leaned against a shingle shack, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The only color in the pile.
